description: This file defines a Swift class `VoiceWakeOverlayController` that manages a lightweight, borderless overlay panel displaying voice wake transcript information near the menu bar. It includes properties for managing UI presentation, state, configuration, and internal enums for source and various outcomes, as well as initialization logic.

classes.name: VoiceWakeOverlayController
classes.description: A controller class managing the overlay panel that displays voice wake transcript information.
